column1: # Game profile of Pokémon Pokopia (Switch 2, update v327680). Plays on the Mac
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL engine on NVN2 (the Switch 2's NVN), SDK 20.5.25 built for the Switch 2 (sdk spec Ounce). Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: WebM movies) + sdk.
# Packed from a dump folder (scripts/pack_dump.py). RomFS: the newer RDB (as ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE's): motor_asset_re/KIDS_PLATFORM_OUNCE/root.rdb and system.rdb
# (indexes, .rdx beside them) over .fdata files named by KTID; movies in movie_asset/ounce/*.webm.
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's layout, not measured here). The NPDM declares no system resource: the game sets a heap.
# 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 9 GB heap region
# The rewritten modules take 82 MB (0x5200000), more than the default 64 MB of used memory, which SetHeapSize checks the game's request (pool − used) against
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; KTGL G2S and _DOK containers in the RDB entries, GLSLC outputs in main) ----
# KTGL rewrites +0x08 and GLSLC's compile hash at +0x20 of a shader's NVN2 control section when it loads it (0x0b → 0x11, a new hash; the code area stays byte for byte):
# without the skip, 13 of the language screen's 27 runtime programs named no packaged shader
